description: Returns the posts newly discovered (first stored by our crawler) since your last check, across all the profiles you are monitoring. Free to call. Each call advances a per-profile cursor, so a subsequent call only returns posts crawled after it (a feed, not a re-scan). New posts arrive when a profile's scheduled refresh crawl runs, on the cadence set by track_profile. Results are the same flattened post shape as search_outliers (stats, thumbnail, handle). Total posts are capped (limit 1–100, default 50). Cost: free.
name: get_tracked_updates
title: Get New Posts From Monitored Profiles
